name: Target-Date Retirement Fund

yield.notes: Designed for retirement accumulation, not near-term cash flow. Automatically rebalances over time.

flags: Not designed for near-term income generation
Fund gradually shifts to bonds as target date approaches

startup_checklist: Open IRA if not already using employer 401k (Vanguard, Fidelity, Schwab)
Choose target date fund matching expected retirement year (e.g., 2050 if retiring in ~25 years)
Set up automatic contribution (even $50/mo to start)
Do not touch until retirement — this is long-term accumulation
failure_modes: Withdrawing early triggers penalties and taxes
Wrong target year leads to overly conservative allocation
kill_criteria: Better retirement vehicle available (e.g., self-directed IRA for specific investments)
Expense ratio above 0.2% (switch to lower-cost equivalent)
sources_note: Fund data from Vanguard, Fidelity, and Schwab prospectuses.
